new.statement: Games with a more novel loop (profiled novelty 2-3 rather than 0-1) rank higher on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
new.action: Add one unfamiliar twist to a known loop

new.statement: Games with an update tag in the title ([UPD], [NEW], version numbers) rank lower on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
new.action: Keep update tags out of the title

new.statement: Satisfying-task games (ASMR cleaning, unscrewing every screw, slime making, draining an ocean) form a steady Up-and-Coming cluster because the page thumbnails show the finished satisfying result
new.action: Show the satisfying payoff in thumbnails
new.rationale: Today Deep Clean ASMR (#45), Unscrew Every Screw (#65), Slime Studio (#70) and Drink the Ocean (#93) all sit on Up-and-Coming. Confirm if the cluster keeps refilling for two more weeks with new members; refute if they fall off together.

new.statement: Licensed-look skins on the +1 template (Sonic hedgehog, Naruto jutsu, bow forge) reach Up-and-Coming and Top Earning with near-identical loops, so the skin rather than the mechanic drives their discovery
new.rationale: Hedgehog Evolve (Up-and-Coming #43), +1 Jutsu Evolution (#89) and +1 Bow Forge (Top Earning #193) share the +1 loop with different IP skins. Needs the +1 loop to show more spread by skin than by mechanic across tracked games.

qualitative_updates.note: Throw Food For Clowns (Up-and-Coming #47, 152K favorites), Throw a Friend for Monsters (#77) and Cast For Fish (#63) all arrived in two weeks with the same throw-distance-for-rarity loop; Steal an Anime Pack (Top Earning #232) is the pack variant.
Pleb's Plane Crash Sandbox (#18) and Realistic Plane Crashing (#38) are two new plane-crash physics entries within 13 days of each other on Up-and-Coming.

Thanksgiving tags now appear on Revolver Arena, Garden Tower Defense, Dragon Tower Defense, Ditch Hotel, Bubble Gum Simulator Infinity, Ro-Bass Fishing, Rooster Rivals and Trading Card Shop, mostly paired with an update.
Mukbang Students (school role reversal, Top Trending #60) adds a school/teacher entrant; no new streamer-themed entrants today.
